episodes.final_message: I haven't gotten your recent sleep or stress check-ins over the past couple of days, and I know you have deadlines on your plate today. How are your energy and stress levels holding up right now?

With 3 deadlines hitting today during midterms and your stress peaking at 5/5, it is completely understandable that things feel heavy and isolating right now. Please remember you don't have to carry this all on your own. Dartmouth's Counseling Center at Dick's House ((603) 646-9442) offers free, confidential support and an after-hours on-call counselor, and the 988 Lifeline (call or text 988) is available 24/7. For tonight, give yourself permission to step back, take a breath, and pause.
